Definition: a primary verb; to crush:--bruise. Compare G4486.
BiblicalUsage: The word thraúō is the Bible's way of saying to crush, to bruise. In Luke 4:18, to set at liberty them that are bruised.
TheologicalSignificance: Jesus coming to set the bruised free is the promise I hold onto when I feel crushed and no one else notices.
